lead.headline: Rice is out again and Pickens is quiet — but Bloodsports lead by 27.2 and the opponent is done
lead.deck: Golden and Pickens are playing in Green Bay, Daniels plays Monday, Los Cachanillas are final at 88.62. ESPN: 99% for a first win.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice was inactive for a second week with no return date; George Pickens has 2.6 tonight, healthy but untargeted early (Yahoo); C.J. Stroud's 23.0 sat on the bench. None of it is costing the week: Tuten (24.7), Likely (23.9), Taylor (21.1) and Matt Gay (12, five better than the Myers he replaced) have Bloodsports up 115.8 to 88.62 with Los Cachanillas finished. Golden has 17.1 in progress and Daniels plays Monday. After that, Washington and Jacksonville are on bye: Stroud starts, and Josh Jacobs — off the exempt list Monday and expected to start at Detroit — or Gordon takes Tuten's slot on Tuesday's projections.
